options.name: apps
options.description: Restrict checks to specific applications. Default is to check all applications.

options.name: databases
options.description: Specify databases to run checks against. If not specified, Django does not run database tests. The parameter has been renamed to O(databases) in community.general 11.3.0. The old name is still available as an alias.

options.name: deploy
options.description: Include additional checks relevant in a deployment setting.

options.name: fail_level
options.description: Message level that triggers failure. Default is the Django default value. Check the documentation for the version being used.

options.name: pythonpath
options.description: Adds the given filesystem path to the Python import search path. The value is passed as is to the C(--pythonpath) argument in C(django-admin).

options.name: settings
options.description: Specifies the settings module to use. The value is passed as is to the C(--settings) argument in C(django-admin).

options.name: skip_checks
options.description: Skips running system checks prior to running the command.

options.name: traceback
options.description: Provides a full stack trace in the output when a C(CommandError) is raised.

options.name: venv
options.description: Use the Python interpreter from this virtual environment. Pass the path to the root of the virtualenv, not the C(bin/) directory nor the C(python) executable.

options.name: verbosity
options.description: Specifies the amount of notification and debug information in the output of C(django-admin).
